packageRules.description: @react-three/fiber 9.8.2 augments react/jsx-runtime's JSX namespace, which @types/react 19.2.16+ (and 19.3) re-exports instead of declaring; Three intrinsic elements (mesh, circleGeometry, ...) then fail to typecheck. Hold @types/react at 19.2.15 or older until fiber supports the re-exported JSX namespace.
